label: Modular pipeline step
description: Run one tool module (fastp, SPAdes, QUAST, MAFFT, ...) on workspace data. Besides the parameters below, give each of the module's input ports and parameters as a top-level key named after it (see `modpipe show <module>`); input ports take workspace paths (files, or output folders of earlier ModularStep/ModularPipeline jobs) or pipeline source objects. GoWe workflows chain these steps.

parameters.label: Input types
parameters.desc: Optional map of input port -> concrete data type (e.g. {"reads": "reads.short.single"}) for inputs whose type can't be inferred from the data.

parameters.label: File Basename
parameters.desc: Name of the job result; outputs go to <output_path>/.<output_file>/<output port>[/<sample>]/
